name: Liberty Cove Recreation Area
note: Little Blue NRD recreation area on a 37-acre spring-fed no-wake lake in Webster County, 2 mi west and 2 mi south of Lawrence on graded gravel county roads. The electric pads are angled back-ins off a short spur south of the park road, behind the shelters and day-use lawn; tents only in the area behind the dam. Two restrooms, well water, swim beach, boat ramp and dock, playground, arboretum, hiking and horse trails; archery deer/turkey hunting in season. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Little Blue NRD recreation page (littlebluenrd.org/recreation/, read 2026-11-05): 'Eight RV camper pads with electrical hookups ($20 per night fee; effective May 1, 2021)' + LBNRD Daily Camper Fees Schedule (effective May 1, 2021): Liberty Cove '$20.00 per night for 30/50 Amp Electrical Camper Sites' + Liberty Cove Site Specific Rules (updated July 2026) 04.01A: 'trailer or recreation vehicles is permitted in designated areas' (vehicular campers barred only behind the dam), map marks 'Electrical Hookups' south of the lake + Esri World Imagery 2025-07-11 and Wayback 2021-10-19: five angled gravel back-in pads ~20-24 m long on a spur off the park road, a white trailer-sized unit parked at the gravel lot ~110 m west in both captures; Campendium review 2023-10-18 (24-ft Class C, 'could easily stay the night') + Google Maps 4.4 on 79 reviews, phone 402-364-2145 -> real NRD drive-in RV campground. Public (local): no price gate.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-05: Esri World Imagery 2025-07-11 (export 0.27 m/px, rendered) and Esri Wayback 2021-10-19 / 2025-07-11 z18-z19 (rendered) at 40.26428,-98.30155: the angled pad row sits south of the gravel park road, ~100-110 m from the lake's south shore, with the road, a picnic shelter/restroom on a mowed day-use lawn, a dense tree clump just NW of the pads, a treeline on their east side and shore trees between -> developed/used strip plus screening, no confirmed sightline from any pad -> not waterfront (unsure goes down; no per-site map exists, the NRD map only labels 'Electrical Hookups'). The other possible pad spot, the gravel lot ~110 m west (40.26487,-98.30257), is also behind the park road and the shelter/playground area, ~55-70 m from the water through trees. Lake is 37 acres (NRD), so a lake not a pond. Dam check: the earthen dam runs along the lake's SE side, its west abutment ~150 m NE of the pads; the pads are on the lake side west of the dam axis, USGS 3DEP 571.6 m at the pads vs 567.6 m on the open water (4 m above pool, not below the dam).

fees.note: $20 a night for a 30/50-amp electric camper site (schedule effective May 1, 2021, still the one linked in 2026); tents on those sites at no extra charge. Pay within 30 minutes of set-up; permits expire 6 pm the next day. No annual park permit required.

fees_source: https://littlebluenrd.org/wp-content/uploads/Daily_Camper_Fees_Schedule_2021.pdf, read 2026-11-05: 'Liberty Cove Recreation Area, Webster County and Lone Star Recreation Area, Fillmore County $20.00 per night for 30/50 Amp Electrical Camper Sites. (Tents may be erected at such sites without additional charges.)'; 'No Annual Park Permits are Required.'; the only RV class here is electric (NRD page: 'Eight RV camper pads with electrical hookups'), fee shape copied from sibling 2815 Lone Star
booking_source: https://littlebluenrd.org/wp-content/uploads/Final-07_14_2026-Park-Rules-Regulations.pdf, read 2026-11-05: '01.05C Campsites are provided on a first-come, first-served basis.'; '01.05I Camping is permitted for a maximum of fourteen (14) consecutive days on any single area during any thirty (30) - day period.'
flags: Duplicate check: no entry named Liberty Cove / Little Blue at this lake; nearest DB campgrounds are 2806 Harbine Park (21 km) and 2688 Crystal Lake Ayr (24 km). Not on RV Life (Algolia bbox 40.20-40.33, -98.40 - -98.20 and name query both empty).

Pin is the angled pad row (Esri 2025). The NRD names 8 electric pads but imagery shows only 5 angled pads on the spur (5-6 lines in 2021); the other ~3 are probably at the gravel lot ~110 m west (40.26487,-98.30257), where a white RV-sized unit sits in both the 2021 and 2025 captures. The NRD map has two 'Electrical Hookups' labels, consistent with two pad groups. Google pin 40.26541,-98.30326 is the shelter/road area ~170 m NW.

Directions differ slightly: NRD page '2 miles west, 2 miles south and 1/4 west of Lawrence'; Site Specific Rules 'two miles west, two miles south, one-half mile west' (S1/2 Sec 35 T4N R9W, Webster County). Imagery fits either.

Waterfront: sibling 2815 Lone Star got lakeview at a similar 80-110 m set-back; here the pad row's view north is screened by a tree clump and shore trees, so I went down to not waterfront. A dated photo from a pad showing the lake would lift it to lakeview.

Structured data for stamping: hookups.electric 50 (fee schedule '30/50 Amp Electrical Camper Sites', read 2026-11-05; Campendium's '20 Amp' is an aggregator figure, ignored); water/sewer at site not stated (leave absent); sites.count 8 (NRD recreation page 'Eight RV camper pads with electrical hookups' / '8 electrial camper pads', read 2026-11-05); max_rig_ft 40 (General Regulations 01.05K 'Camper units may not exceed 102" in width and forty (40) feet in length', district-wide boilerplate citing state statute); pull-through: none seen (angled back-ins on imagery); booking reservable false, fcfs always, max_stay_nights 14 (General Regulations 01.05C/01.05I, approved 07/14/2026); facilities: restrooms 2 ('two restrooms', type not stated), potable water from a well ('well water', NRD page), swim beach, boat ramp + dock, playground, 2 shelters; dump: none stated by the NRD (Campendium lists none on site; leave absent); season not stated for Liberty Cove (do not copy Lone Star's Apr 1-Dec 1).

Prairie Lake (lead 9): NRD page says 20 RV camper pads with electric, $20/night 'effective April 1, 2022' (it is not on the 2021 fee schedule PDF), shelter, restroom, well water, archery range (closed to camping per SSR 06.02E), no boat launch; location 'NW1/4 Sec 31 T7N R10W, Adams County, three miles south and one mile east of Juniata' per the July 2026 SSR, but the NRD page says '3 miles south and 1/4 mile east of Juniata' - check which on imagery.

Buckley Creek (lead 10): NRD page contradicts itself - '6 camper hookups ($15 per night fee; effective May 1, 2021)' in the text vs 'four electrical camper pads' in the bullet list; fee schedule: '$15.00 per night for 30/50 Amp Electrical Camper Sites'; also 'plenty of tent camping', nine-hole sand-green golf course, rural water, motors under 5 HP; NW1/4 Sec 10 T1N R1E Jefferson County, 1 mi E and 1/2 mi N of Reynolds (SSR July 2026).
All Little Blue NRD areas: FCFS only, 14 days in 30, 40-ft / 102-in unit limit, no park permit, phone 402-364-2145 (NRD office, Davenport) - same as on Google for Liberty Cove and Lone Star.
